data.one_liner: Flutter SDK for processing payments and tokenization via YooKassa API.
data.what_it_does: Allows integrating the YooKassa payment interface into Flutter applications for Android and iOS. It uses native YooKassa mobile SDKs underneath to handle tokenization, payment forms, and payment confirmation methods like 3-D Secure, SberPay, SBP, and Alfa Pay.
use_when: You need to accept payments in your Flutter app using the YooKassa payment gateway.
You want native payment forms and built-in handling for SberPay, SBP, Alfa Pay, and bank cards.
avoid_when: Your target payment gateway is not YooKassa.
You are targeting platforms other than Android and iOS.
strengths: Provides ready-to-use native payment and tokenization UI forms for Android and iOS.
Supports a wide array of payment methods including YooMoney, SberPay, SBP, and Alfa Pay.
Allows explicit version control of underlying native SDKs.
weaknesses: Requires manual configuration of platform-specific deeplinks and URL schemes for external banking apps.
Android app process death during an external payment flow can cause payment results to not be delivered.
data.setup_notes: Requires setting a client application key and shop ID from YooKassa. Android requires setting up app schemes in build.gradle, and iOS requires setting up application schemes in Info.plist and handling links in AppDelegate.

alternatives.name: flutter_stripe
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose this if you are processing payments through Stripe instead of YooKassa.

alternatives.name: adyen_checkout
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose this if you are processing payments through Adyen instead of YooKassa.
